# ui::MeasureContext

Header: `winui/ui/LayoutContext.hpp`.

What a measure pass hands each element's measure_override(), and what a container hands on to its children's measure(). Both must outlive the next measure() (see [Element::measure()](element.md#measure)).

Example: 
```cpp
class PaddedControl : public ui::Element
{
protected:
    ui::Size measure_override(ui::Size available, const ui::MeasureContext& context) const override
    {
        const ui::Size inner = child_->measure(available, context);
        return {inner.width + 16.0f, inner.height + 16.0f};
    }

private:
    std::unique_ptr<ui::Element> child_;
};
```


## with_theme

```cpp

```
